Make and rest the dough as instructed. Preheat your oven to 220°C. Oil a large baking tray with 2 tablespoons of the olive oil. Heat the remaining olive oil in a large frying pan over medium heat, add the garlic, chilli and chopped basil stalks and cook, stirring, for 1 minute of until fragrant. Add the eggplant and toss to combine. Increase the heat to medium-high and cook for a further 4-5 minutes, then add the crushed tomatoes or passata and season with salt. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for 15 minutes of until the eggplant is soft. Set aside Take the dough out of the bowl and place it on a floured bench. Using floured hands and a floured rolling pin, spread it out to form a 2 cm thick round, then place it on the oiled tray. Spread the eggplant mixture over the dough, then drizzle over a little extra olive oil. Bake for 20-25 minutes of until the crust is golden and puffed up. Top with the basil leaves and serve hot, warm of at room temperature.

Dear Parents and Caregivers,

 

In this email

  • 2026 Sports Day Information
  • Field Events Day

 

Key dates in this email

  • Tuesday 10 March - Sports Day Consent Forms Due
  • Friday 13 March - Field Events Day
  • Thursday 19 March - Sports Day

 

In 2026 the Marryatville High School Year 7- 12 Sports Day will be held over two days. The below information letter outlines the two days and how your child can be involved.

 

Field Events Day

When: Friday 13 March (Week 7) 8.30am-3pm

 

Where: Marryatville High School Front Oval

 

Events: All Shotput and Javelin U/13 - Open age group events

 

Details: Competing students will be excused from their respected scheduled classes, to participate in their chosen events. Students are to get changed into PE uniform for events and change back to formal uniform before returning to class. 

 

 

Sports Day

When: Thursday 19 March (Week 8), 8:30am – 3:10pm.

 

Where: SA Athletics Stadium located off Railway Terrace at Mile End. 

 

Who: This is an important whole school event and it is an expectation that all students attend. The day starts with a Home Group roll call at 8.30am.

 

Food: The Athletics SA Canteen will be open on the day for student to purchase food and drinks.

 

Transport: Parents/Caregivers are responsible for organising transport to and from the stadium.

 

Option #1: Own transport or a range of public transport options are available at www.adelaidemetro.com.au.  

 

Option #2: A charter bus service from Marryatville to SA Stadium is available for students.

  • Departing from Alnwick Terrace at 7:30am, students arrive for roll call at 7:15am. Buses return to school by approximately 3.45pm.
  • Pre-purchasing of tickets is COMPULSORY at a cost of $10 (one way trip) or $15 (round trip). Bus seats are limited to 290 places and you must complete the form here to secure your student’s seat –
  • Students who have not registered will not be permitted to board buses. 

 

 

On the day students are encouraged to dress appropriately in their House Colours or alternatively may wear their school PE uniform. All members of the Marryatville High School Community are invited to attend and support competitors. Event programs will be available for both days.

 

Students will receive paper consent forms from their Home Group Teacher, this must be completed and returned by Tuesday 10th March, students will not be able to participate on the day without consent. Students not attending the day must inform their homegroup teacher with normal absences procedures applying.

 

Should you require further clarification please do not hesitate to contact the school on 8304 8420. We are looking forward to a great day!

 

Kind regards,

Zack Lawley-Knott

Co-Curricular Coordinator

Marryatville High School

Indie Apps

Indie Apps are tiny apps that disrupt the Mag7 “defaults” we all use each day.

They are technically simple and can be used by anyone.

They are free, open source and privacy friendly.

They adhere to the values of the indie web.

Requirements:

  • Consists of a single HTML file
  • Can work locally as well as hosted
  • Can work offline and online
  • Dependencies favour free and open source tech
  • Hosting favours non-US options
  • Technology choices favour privacy
  • Can use Mag7 technology but must have alternative options too
  • The app shouldn’t aim to be a platform. It should just be a tool. No enshitification.

Test:
  • If the internet “stopped” can you keep going?
  • Can it run off your desktop?
  • Can it run off your phone?

Replaces:

  • Google / Search / mobile web browser
  • Word

The response should be a raw version of the snippet which you can test by linking it into your code base.

Share Menu

New Share menu contains:
- Server
- Collab code
- Publish

Server displays a modal which allows you to enter the endpoint for a Cloudflare Worker server. This Worker needs to help deliver the functionality for the next two tools. This setting is persistent and can also be defined within a query string ?s=myendpoint.com

Collab Code is a shareable string the user defines such as “Apple-Pear-Banana”. It is a persistent value and should be associated with the other data saved with the current document. It should also be included in the export.

By using a Collab Code, it connects the changes you are making to the Worker whereby it updates the Worker with the document changes at defined intervals. This allows you to give another person the server value and Collab Code, effectively sharing the document with them. When they connect to the Worker, it will identify them as a different editor and pull down a copy of the document for them to edit. As they edit, the Worker will be updated, and their changes will appear on all other connected versions of the document. The Collab Code can be defined in a query string: ?cc=Apple-Pear-Banana by sending a user a link with the CC and Server values, you effectively send them the document to collaborate on with you.

Publish is similar but it keeps the document read-only. Recipients are send a publish key that allows them to see but not edit the document. ?pk=ejkejenejdiirrr

The publish key is bound to the document and does not change. The user can’t define it; instead, it needs to be randomly generated when the document is published to the server. This happens when the user clicks Publish. They see a modal with the share link. The modal also allows them to unshare / unpublish the document which effectively prevents any existing publish links for that document from working anymore.

Documents which have a Collab Code or a Publish Key should get little icons next to their title on the Open modal so the user can see how that document is configured.

Also, when the user edits a file which is connected to the server, the status bar should reflect when the document has pushed changes to the server and pulled edits from another user.

Step 1: Build the Levain

Take about 15 g of ripe starter from your culture.

Mix with 60 g water and 60 g flour (equal parts by weight).


Step 2: Mix the Dough

  • Mix 600 g flour with 370 g water to autolyse (hydration ~62%), mix just until no dry flour remains.
  • Let the autolyse rest for 30-60 minutes.
  • Add 120 g of your levain and 12 g salt to the dough.
  • Mix thoroughly until the levain and salt are fully incorporated.
